design_receipt.design: Equal-probability species selection within near/far original photographic same/different 2x2 cells; one near and far source pair per sampled species-cell. Pair probabilities conditional on source label strata are recorded in private unblinding key. Both pairs have different original observers, same calendar month, source accuracy <=5km, near<=50km versus far>=250km. Independent classified/unclassified source photo control panel sampled one photo per species per original status.
design_receipt.minimum_photo_quality: source original georeferenced classifiable pairs with observer id, same calendar month, and <=5000m coordinate uncertainty
restricted_claims: No visual human scores are provided; these are BLANK review sheets only
Stratification by original photo labels is deliberately outcome-enriched and NOT a random population estimate
The dual-opportunity taxon frame and >=250km far comparator are different from the original all-range P2 estimand
No claims of validated petals, genetic morph persistence, temperature adaptation or global classifier accuracy
Pairs may share source photographs and species across strata; analyse and bootstrap by species and genus, not raw pair count
Source photo pages provide links, not reproduced original images; reviewers must check licence, access and tissue
Form scoring, actual third reader adjudication and source-weighted re-estimation are separate future steps

limitations: No actual human flower-organ scoring completed; all blank form fields are empty
Source photographic agreement strata intentionally enrich source mismatch and do not estimate global classifier error rates
The strict same-month, <=5km coordinate-accuracy, <=50km near and >=250km far dual-opportunity subset differs from the original 3600-species P2 all-geographic pair contrast
Taxa/photos may recur among selected source strata, so aggregate statistical uncertainty must cluster by taxon or genus
Species-selection probabilities are conditional on original source-label strata, not weights for the entire 4475-species registry
Unblinding key is preserved separately; should not be sent to reviewers
A source-label heldout pair sample is not proof of genetic flower morphs or climate adaptation
